versions.content: In case the Dem_J1939DcmSetRatioFilter, Dem_J1939DcmSetDTCFilter or Dem_J1939DcmSetFreezeFrameFilter returns E_OK , the values in parameter ‘LampStatus’ shall be encoded into the response message layout according to SAE J1939 - 73.
